# Public keys

Three cosign public keys live here — `build.pub`, `review.pub`, `release.pub` —
one per GitHub Environment, generated by the one-time setup in
`SETUP-ENVIRONMENTS.md`. Only the `.pub` halves are ever committed.

`review.yml` verifies the build actor's evidence against `build.pub`. Deleting
that file does not make Review lenient — it makes Review fail at the verify
step, which is the correct behaviour: a review that passed without a key to
check against would be verifying nothing.

Each file must be the public half of the key held as `COSIGN_PRIVATE_KEY` in the
matching environment. Replacing one here without rotating the environment secret
breaks verification with a signature error, not a missing-key error, so rotate
both halves together.

Private keys never come here. `.gitignore` refuses `*.key` and `*.pem`.
